title: Office and image export writers
notes: Library half of the export pair per ADR 0012 (docs/decisions/0012-feature-tasks-split-library-and-shell.md). Serves acceptance item A-27 (Export PDF to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, image, text, HTML and RTF, with Office opening the result) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Reads the open document through the pdfxi-document session of ADR 0010 and writes the export formats behind a format-selection API with declared fidelity limits; proves each writer on fixtures/realworld/** read-only and reopens the result where an independent reader exists. A serialised app shell task follows once this lands and owns the Export card in crates/pdfxi-app/src/shell/**; matrix rows stay `library` until that shell task verifies them.
